basic_info.description: Charming detached cottage-style home in Silver Terrace. Situated on a spacious 2,500 square foot lot, this home offers ample storage space on the ground floor. Featuring living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom on the main level, this home provides comfortable living spaces for the whole family. Conveniently located near transit options, freeway access, Alemany Farmer's Market, and Bayview and San Bruno Ave shopping. Enjoy the large fenced front yard, perfect for outdoor gatherings and relaxation.3rd party property inspections provided are for informational purposes only Buyers are advised to get any and all inspections they deem necessary. Buyers should also verify all square footage and any and all room counts, room legality and permit history for themselves.
